tools.name: generate_names
tools.description: Generate random name ideas that already follow the platform's username rules (length, allowed characters, underscores): Twitch channel names, generic gamertags, Minecraft, Roblox, Discord usernames, Discord server names, Fortnite (Epic) display names, Valorant Riot IDs, Xbox gamertags and clan names

tools.name: check_username
tools.description: Check whether a Minecraft (Java Edition) or Roblox username is available, using the platforms' official lookups. Returns available, taken (with a profile link) or invalid (with the reason). Pair it with generate_names to find a free name. Results are cached for a minute.

tools.name: style_text
tools.description: Convert plain text into Unicode "font" styles that paste anywhere fonts can't be changed: Discord and Twitch chat, usernames, bios, stream titles. Styles: bold (Bold), italic (Italic), bolditalic (Bold italic), sansbold (Sans bold), sansitalic (Sans italic), sansbolditalic (Sans bold italic), script

tools.name: discord_timestamp
tools.description: Make Discord timestamp codes like <t:1767225600:F> that show a date and time in every reader's own time zone, for event announcements and stream schedules. Pass an ISO 8601 date-time with its UTC offset (e.g. "2026-12-31T20:00:00-05:00") or a Unix timestamp in seconds. Returns all seven formats.

tools.description: Estimate a Twitch streamer's monthly and yearly income from paid subs (tiers 1–3), Prime subs, Bits and ads, using the same formula as the TwitchBoard sub calculator. tools.name: estimate_kick_earnings
tools.description: Estimate a Kick streamer's monthly sub income with Kick's 95/5 split, compared with a 50/50 split. Gifted subs count as subs.

tools.name: estimate_tiktok_earnings
tools.description: Estimate a TikTok creator's monthly income from Creator Rewards views, LIVE gifts (diamonds) and brand deals. TikTok publishes none of these rates, so every rate is an editable assumption: $0.50 per 1,000 qualified views, $0.005 per diamond and $10 per 1,000 followers per sponsored post by default.

tools.name: convert_tiktok_coins
tools.description: Convert TikTok coins (or a gift's coin price) to what the viewer pays in USD and roughly what the creator receives. Default coin price is a 100-coin pack for $1.29 and a 50% creator share; both are editable because TikTok prices vary by country and platform.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: search_tools, style_text · Private data: get_image_size · Public sink: search_tools, get_stream_settings, estimate_tiktok_earnings, convert_tiktok_coins.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: search_tools, style_text · Private data: get_image_size · Public sink: search_tools, get_stream_settings, estimate_tiktok_earnings, convert_tiktok_coins

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
